title: Dinner Lady Blackberry Crumble Shortfill E-Liquid
description: One of Dinner Lady’s most iconic juices, Blackberry Crumble perfectly captures the sweet, jammy blackberry centre of a freshly made crumble, layered with a comforting buttery crust. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
